Please mail, fax, or hand deliver completed forms to the Financial Aid Office unless otherwise advised on the form. Link to a PDF file (Requires Adobe Reader ) General Forms Form Title Links Form Description Guarantee Your Stafford Loan Instructions for student to guarantee their Stafford loan on the Loans by Web website. Federal Plus Loan Instructions Instructions for parents to apply for a PLUS loan on the Loans by Web website. Parent Loan Borrower Authorization Form Form letting the Financial Aid Office know how the PLUS loan funds should be delivered to UTD from the lender. GRAD PLUS Loan Instructions Follow these instructions if you are a graduate student, were awarded a GRAD PLUS loan, and wish to take out the loan. Standards Of Academic Progress Information page detailing what criteria is used to determine standards of academic progress as it relates to students receiving financial aid. Satisfactory Academic Progress Appeal Form Complete this form if you were place on financial aid suspension and want to appeal that decision. Financial Aid Hours Adjustment Form Complete this form if you are planning on taking fewer hours in any given semester than you intended to take when you completed your FAFSA. Certification of Transfer Credit for ACG/SMART Grant Form used to determine eligibility for ACG/SMART grant funds for transfer hours. Title IV Aid Refunds and Repayment Requirements Title IV refunds and repayments insert for award letters. Explains what happens to aid if a student decides to drop classes at UTD. Non-Degree/Certificate of Required Preparatory Coursework Form Form required for Non-Degree students to receive financial aid.
